assumptions: This is a virtual screening scenario and is not a claim about a deployed cluster.
Per-GPU 500 TFLOP/s is an assumed sustained training rate, distinct from NVIDIA's public peak specification.
Each WAN link is assumed to provide dedicated 25 Gbit/s payload bandwidth with 20 ms one-way latency.
The 70B dense model uses an approximate 140 GB BF16 gradient payload and 1.12 TB full training-state checkpoint.
The delay-response prior extrapolates beyond the cited paper and carries uncertainty large enough to expose that evidence gap.
The paper reports final validation loss, not learning progress per FLOP; GPUSTACK does not treat those as interchangeable measurements.
evidence_gaps: no held-out multi-site learning observations are attached to this run
the learning response is an unfitted sensitivity prior seeded only by one-step 360M Muon final-loss observations
progress per FLOP and completion-time falsifiers are not evaluated from the screening prior
the implemented controller adapts synchronization cadence only; topology, parallelism, optimizer correction, and state migration remain absent
single-site centralized, sparse-gossip, migration-only, and future-trace oracle baselines remain absent
outage overlap postpones whole operations and does not yet model preemption, lost work, or checkpoint recovery
collective traffic is payload per modeled WAN link, not a complete algorithm-specific all-reduce byte model
energy includes site base power and accelerator compute demand only; dynamic network, checkpoint, storage, host, and cooling energy are unmodeled
site base power remains constant through the assumed outage; no measured curtailment or recovery power waveform is attached

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: No baseline may be omitted from a superiority or regret claim.

evidence_requirements.acceptance_rule: The complete modeled boundaries must pass admission before their metrics can support E001.
evidence_requirements.description: Traffic and interruption claims require algorithm-specific collective bytes plus preemption, lost-work, and recovery semantics.
evidence_requirements.evidence_boundary: Payload-per-link and whole-operation postponement are insufficient.

falsifiers.description: Less than 95% centralized progress per FLOP falsifies E001.
More than 10% of synchronous collective payload fails the preregistered 10x reduction threshold.
